chunks: Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Muhammad ibn Ismaʿil ibn Baziʿ, from Abu al-Hasan al-Rida عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who recites in the الحمّام and has intercourse in it. He said: “There is no harm in it.”

key_terms.بِهِ: in it; referring to the mentioned act
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; an expression of permissibility
key_terms.يَقْرَأُ: recites; here, reciting in the bathhouse

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to recite and have intercourse in the bathhouse according to Imam al-Rida عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that there is no objection to reciting in the bathhouse and having intercourse there. It addresses permissibility in matters connected with ritual context and private marital conduct.
